Docs.summary: Provides callbacks, change information, and schema filters for observing changes to AppSearch data.

remarks.para: Implement to receive document and schema change notifications. identifies changed documents, and identifies changed schema types.

Use to select schema types for an observer. An empty schema filter matches all schema types. Document changes caused by schema migration are reported as schema changes, not as individual document changes.
Android observer callback reference, document change reference, and observer specification reference.
